# Pickleball Booking Platform Context

This repository contains a Next.js 16 frontend and an Express.js/PostgreSQL backend for a Pickleball Court Booking Platform.

- Main Index: [docs/README.md](docs/README.md)

## Core Files
- Server Router: [server/src/app.js](server/src/app.js)
- Database Schema: [server/prisma/schema.prisma](server/prisma/schema.prisma)
- Frontend Pages Root: [web/src/app](web/src/app)

## Core Architecture Snapshot
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 App Router with Cache Components, Partial Prerendering, Server Components, and edge proxy with proactive token refresh. Route groups: `(marketing)`, `(booking)`, `(auth)`, `(dashboard)`, `(admin)`. Server-side auth via `getSession()` — no client-side auth context.
- **Availability Ownership**: Handled fully inside the `venues` module; availability slots are generated dynamically from base schedules and exception overlays.
- **Concurrency Safety**: Double-bookings are prevented atomically at slot hold creation time by a PostgreSQL partial unique index (`booking_slots_no_double_book`) on the `booking_slots` table.
- **Booking Holds**: Active holds are represented as pending bookings (status `pending_payment`) with a 10-minute expiration TTL.
- **Payment Gateway Abstraction**: Integrations use a common payment provider interface. Local development and test environments run on the mock `sandbox` payment provider.
- **Reward Engine**: Confirmed bookings atomically issue reward instances (weighted draw, outcome hidden until reveal) inside the confirmation transaction. Prizes are external offer vouchers with staff-tracked redemption — never wallet credits (ADR-010). Module: `server/src/modules/rewards`; customer UI: scratch overlay auto-presents on the booking-confirmation page (teaser card fallback in the right panel) and on `/dashboard/rewards` (`RewardExperience`); admin UI: `/admin/rewards` (redemption desk + mechanism editor). Scratch card is the only reward experience in the web app.
